content.title: Jefferies downgrades Tapestry on valuation after stock run
content.summary: Investing.com -- Jefferies downgraded Tapestry to Hold from Buy, saying most of the near-term upside is reflected in the stock after a strong rally that has pushed valuations well above historical levels.Stock has gained 31% in last six months. It now trades in the low-20s on a forward P/E basis, compared with a historical average of about 12x and roughly 16x for peers.
